name: Pantanal
about: Dry season Jul–Oct concentrates wildlife along riverbanks, wet season Nov–Mar floods much of the region.
overview: The world's best jaguar-viewing — a vast wetland teeming with wildlife, far easier to spot than in dense Amazon rainforest.
costOverview: The Pantanal splits sharply by ambition — a basic ranch stay runs a couple hundred dollars a day, but the specialized jaguar-tracking lodges in Porto Jofre, where sighting odds run 70-90%, cost several times that.

specialSeasons.text: This is peak jaguar season, as falling water levels concentrate wildlife along the riverbanks.
